title: tree.item_icon_double_clicked doesn't work
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5 stable

### System information

macOS Sequoia 15.5 Godot 4.5 stable

### Issue description

Tree.item_icon_double_clicked doesn't work, only item_activated works.
I already try using it alone,  no luck.

### Steps to reproduce

## steps
1. create a tree and add item with icon to it.
2. connect tree.item_icon_double_clicked signal.
3. Double click icon 

Or you can use this simple plugin to reproduce

## simple plugin for reproduce

``` gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

var dock

func _enter_tree():
	# Create and add dock
	var dock_script = load("res://addons/tree_signal_test/test_tree_dock.gd")
	dock = dock_script.new()
	add_control_to_dock(DOCK_SLOT_LEFT_UL, dock)
	print("Tree Signal Test Plugin: Plugin enabled")

func _exit_tree():
	# Remove dock
	if dock:
		remove_control_from_docks(dock)
		dock.queue_free()
		dock = null
	print("Tree Signal Test Plugin: Plugin disabled")
```

``` gdscript
@tool
extends Control

var tree: Tree
var root_item: TreeItem

func _init():
	name = "Tree Signal Test"
	set_custom_minimum_size(Vector2(200, 300))
	
	# Create vertical layout
	var vbox = VBoxContainer.new()
	add_child(vbox)
	vbox.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	tree = Tree.new()
	tree.set_custom_minimum_size(Vector2(180, 200))
	tree.hide_root = true
	vbox.add_child(tree)
	tree.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	setup_tree()

func setup_tree():
	# Create root item
	root_item = tree.create_item()
	root_item.set_text(0, "Root")
	
	# Add test items with icons
	var test_item1 = tree.create_item(root_item)
	test_item1.set_text(0, "Test Node 1")
	test_item1.set_icon(0, get_theme_icon("Node", "EditorIcons"))
	root_item.set_collapsed(false)
	
	# Connect signals
	connect_signals()

func connect_signals():
	print("Tree Signal Test: Connecting signals...")
	
	# Connect item_activated signal
	if not tree.item_activated.is_connected(_on_item_activated):
		tree.item_activated.connect(_on_item_activated)
		print("Tree Signal Test: item_activated signal connected")
	
	# Connect item_icon_double_clicked signal
	if not tree.item_icon_double_clicked.is_connected(_on_item_icon_double_clicked):
		tree.item_icon_double_clicked.connect(_on_item_icon_double_clicked)
		print("Tree Signal Test: item_icon_double_clicked signal connected")
	
	print("Tree Signal Test: All signals connected")

func _on_item_activated():
	print("=== item_activated signal triggered ===")

func _on_item_icon_double_clicked():
	print("=== item_icon_double_clicked signal triggered ===")

func _ready():
	print("Tree Signal Test Dock: Panel ready")
	print("Please try:")
	print("1. Double-click item text -> should trigger item_activated")
	print("2. Double-click item icon -> should trigger item_icon_double_clicked")
```
